summary: Google DeepMind's Josh Woodward announced that Gemini Spark is expanding to more Ultra subscribers and gaining four features: editing Google Docs, reading comments in Sheets and Slides, and running over 50% faster.

practices.reason: Spark gains concrete new capabilities (editing Docs, reading Sheets/Slides comments) and a stated speed improvement, changing what an assistant-integration team could build with it.
practices.quote: Spark can open and edit Google Docs, acting on feedback from last week
